scope: Plaza standard sample only; this verdict does not represent the full host
decision: The standard sample is materially improved and all tested behavior passes, but it cannot be signed off while the masthead presents decorative platform chrome and a switch affordance with no corresponding action.

evidence: The masthead's visible ellipsis/separator/ring capsule is aria-hidden and has no user-facing function, so it reads as copied system chrome rather than useful navigation.

The product identity includes a downward chevron and switch-like grouping, but .miniapp-switch has no role, focusability or activation handler. The visual promise and behavior disagree at all three viewports.
blockingFindings.requiredOutcome: Remove the pseudo system capsule and inactive switch cue, or replace them with one real, labelled, keyboard-operable host action whose function is evident without brand familiarity. Preserve the restrained editorial masthead rather than adding new decoration.

search.evidence: One outer 1–2px rule contains an explicit Search label and one borderless native input. Computed input border is 0; there is no double frame or phantom lower gap.

systemCoherence.evidence: Header bands are square; search, taxonomy, campaign and card islands consistently use 2–4px radii, thin editorial rules, warm translucent surfaces and a title-first type hierarchy.

brandDirection.evidence: Warm paper remains the dominant canvas. Yellow is restricted to selected controls, red to rules/kickers/actions, and navy to framing. Masked structural recognition passes with the masthead caveat recorded as blocking.

metadataNoise.evidence: Deck tags use quiet neutral fills; author and stats are subordinate; the participation state is an outlined red label instead of a dominant fill.

responsiveLayout.evidence: 390x844, 536x864 and 1280x720 have 0px document overflow. Campaign and first deck card remain in the initial viewport. Compact widths use the native environment rail; desktop wraps without collisions.

evidence: 39/39 environment controls receive focus and become fully visible.

otherRoutes.evidence: Build, mine, event, round and detail mobile screenshots are byte-for-byte identical to Attempt 4 reference captures and each has 0px overflow.
